}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \foreach \i/\a in {1/90,2/18,3/-54,4/-126,5/162} { \coordinate (P\i) at (\a:2.3); }
  % diagonals (dependent)
  \foreach \i/\j in {1/3,1/4,2/4,2/5,3/5} { \draw[figR, densely dashed, line width=0.7pt] (P\i)--(P\j); }
  % edges (free)
  \foreach \i/\j in {1/2,2/3,3/4,4/5,5/1} { \draw[figB, line width=1.3pt] (P\i)--(P\j); }
  \foreach \i/\a in {1/90,2/18,3/-54,4/-126,5/162} { \node[circle, fill=black, inner sep=1.6pt] at (P\i) {}; \node at (\a:2.68) {$p_\i$}; }
  \node[figB, font=\footnotesize] at (54:2.25) {$s_{12}$};
  \node[figB, font=\footnotesize] at (-18:2.3) {$s_{23}$};
  \node[figB, font=\footnotesize] at (-90:2.15) {$s_{34}$};
  \node[figB, font=\footnotesize] at (198:2.3) {$s_{45}$};
  \node[figB, font=\footnotesize] at (126:2.25) {$s_{15}$};
  \node[figR, font=\footnotesize, fill=white, inner sep=1pt] at (1.42,-0.78) {$s_{13}$};
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.3cm]
    \draw[figB, line width=1.3pt] (0,1.1)--(0.8,1.1); \node[right, font=\footnotesize] at (0.9,1.1) {edge: one of the five free invariants};
    \draw[figR, densely dashed, line width=0.7pt] (0,0.5)--(0.8,0.5); \node[right, font=\footnotesize] at (0.9,0.5) {diagonal: fixed by three edges};
    \node[right, font=\footnotesize, align=left] at (-0.1,-0.55) {diagonal = opposite edge $-$ the two edges it spans:\\[3pt] $s_{13} = s_{45} - s_{12} - s_{23}$ \quad (and cyclic, $i \to i+1$)};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
